title: Women's Soccer Expansion Fees Just Went Vertical
source: NWSL expansion fees: roughly $2M for Angel City FC / San Diego Wave (2020-2022 rounds, per Sportico/Yahoo Sports reporting); Bay FC $53M (announced 2023, joined 2024, Just Women's Sports); Denver Summit FC $110M (announced Jan 2025, Sportico -- 'largest in the history of U.S. women's sports'); Columbus $205M (announced April 2026, Sportico/Forbes -- 'nearly double' Denver's fee, the current NWSL record). MLS expansion fees: FC Cincinnati $150M (2018-2019 round); Charlotte FC $325M (2019 announcement, joined 2022, per CBC/Wikipedia); San Diego FC $500M (announced May 2023, joined 2025, per Goal.com/NBC Sports/CBS Sports -- the MLS record, still the benchmark through the 2025-2026 cycle).
